response: {"title":"Ten-percent scope map","intervention":"Spend no more than the first 10% of the deadline listing each explicit acceptance criterion with its likely owning Python module, then use that map to bound the implementation.","claim":"Against no appended instruction, this time-boxed scope map will improve full-task pass_rate on matched dispersed-requirement Python tasks while keeping median wall_time and turns within 10% of control.","mechanism":"A small protected discovery budget reduces premature file selection and omission of remote requirements without allowing open-ended planning to consume the fixed deadline.","assumptions":["Likely module ownership can be estimated within 10% of the available time.","The remaining 90% of the deadline is sufficient for implementation and verification."],"risks":["Incorrect early ownership guesses may anchor subsequent work.","Ten percent may be excessive for short tasks or insufficient for unfamiliar repositories.","Requirements spanning several modules may be forced into one misleading owner."],"test_plan":{"experiment":"Randomly assign matched multi-module Python tasks with fixed deadlines to this appended instruction or no appended instruction using identical agents and evaluation.","metrics":["pass_rate","wall_time","turns"],"success_condition":"Treatment complete-task pass_rate exceeds control and treatment median wall_time and turns are each no more than 110% of control."},"single_shot_ordinal":10}
